name: trellis
description: Trellis — a guided, gated method for building a business with a two-person human team and AI agents: Outcome-Driven Product Definition upstream, Federated Modular Architecture for the build, Outcome-Driven Growth for audience, validation, launch and learning. Seventeen modular skills that read a pipeline state file and guide you to the next step, for new projects or existing ones. Built-in decision-tree discovery and bounded specialist delivery with explicit feedback loops.
